blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Progressive group Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) has rejected Malacañang’s call to defer protests during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit, saying the gathering offers an opportunity to bring its criticisms of the Marcos administration and US policies to the international community. In a statement on Monday, Bayan argued that the presence of regional and world leaders makes the summit an appropriate time to raise concerns over government policies, including the proposed US-led Pax Silica hub in New Clark City, Tarlac. “On the contrary, now is the best time to speak out and hold Marcos accountable for his […]...
